en.bdb: Do not keep company with a foolish one

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉਂ ਮਣਿ ਕਾਲੇ ਸਪ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਵਿਸੂ ਭਰਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: jiau(n) man kaale sap sir saar na jaanai visoo bhariaa|

en.bdb: Having jewel in its head and knowing it not, the snake remains filled with poison.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੁ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਮਿਰਗ ਤਨਿ ਝਾੜਾਂ ਸਿੰਙਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਫਰਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: jaan kathooree mirag tan jhaaRaa(n) si(n)n(g)dhaa firai afariaa|

en.bdb: It is known that musk remains in the body of deer, but it goes on smelling it franatically in the bushes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉਂ ਕਰਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਸਿਪ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਰਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: jiau(n) kar motee sip vich maram na jaanai a(n)dhar dhariaa|

en.bdb: The pearl dwells in the shell but the shell does not know the mystery.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉਂ ਗਾਈ ਥਣਿ ਚਿਚੁੜੀ ਦੁਧੁ ਨ ਪੀਐ ਲੋਹੂ ਜਰਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: jiau(n) gaiee than chichuRee dhudh na peeaai lohoo jariaa|

en.bdb: The tick stuck with the teats of cow, takes not its milk but sucks the blood only.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਗੁਲਾ ਤਰਣਿ ਨ ਸਿਖਿਓ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ਨ ਪਥਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: bagulaa taran na sikhio teerath nai na pathar tariaa|

en.bdb: Living in water the crane never learns how to swim and the stone, in spite of its ablutions at various pilgrimage centres cannot swim and go across.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਲਿ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਭਲੀ ਭਿਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਰਾਜਹੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਸਰਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: naal siaane bhalee bhikh moorakh raajahu kaaj na sariaa|

en.bdb: That is why, begging in the company of wise people is better then ruling over a kingdom alongwith Hoots.
Because he who himself is fake, will also spoil the pure one.
